Ui.Script:
BENILLA_BANK_ITEM_SLOTS = 24 -- NUM_BANKGENERIC_SLOTS (ref BankFrame.lua:3) BENILLA_BANK_BAG_SLOTS = 6 -- NUM_BANKBAGSLOTS (ref BankFrame.lua:4)
function BenillaBankFrame_OnLoad(frame) SetPortraitTexture(getglobal(frame:GetName() .. "Portrait"), "npc") frame:RegisterEvent("BANKFRAME_OPENED") frame:RegisterEvent("BANKFRAME_CLOSED") frame:RegisterEvent("PLAYERBANKSLOTS_CHANGED") frame:RegisterEvent("PLAYERBANKBAGSLOTS_CHANGED") frame:RegisterEvent("PLAYER_MONEY") -- Container -1 is a container like any other: the same lock/cooldown maintenance -- events the bag windows register (BagFrame.xml's BenillaBagFrame_OnLoad), handled -- below by BenillaBankFrame_OnEvent directly (not delegated — the shared window-level -- repaint helper caps at BENILLA_BAG_WINDOW_MAX_SLOTS=20, short of the bank's 24). frame:RegisterEvent("ITEM_LOCK_CHANGED") frame:RegisterEvent("BAG_UPDATE_COOLDOWN") end
-- The banker's name arrives as arg1 of BANKFRAME_OPENED (the app resolves the banker guid -- through the NameCache — the merchant/trainer feed's own ask-once pattern); nil/empty -- until it lands, or if this ever fires with no name, falls back to "Banker". function BenillaBankFrame_SetTitle(name) if name == nil or name == "" then name = "Banker" end getglobal("BenillaBankFrameTitleText"):SetText(name) end
-- Repaint every one of the 24 generic slots (PLAYERBANKSLOTS_CHANGED names ONE slot; the -- spec allows repainting all 24 — cheap, and spares tracking a slot->button map). function BenillaBankFrame_RepaintItems() for i = 1, BENILLA_BANK_ITEM_SLOTS do local button = getglobal("BenillaBankItem" .. i) if button then BenillaBagSlot_Update(button) end end end
-- The bag row (ref UpdateBagSlotStatus, BankFrame.lua:81-117): each button's icon from the -- app-resolved BenillaGetBankBagTexture feed (falling back to the empty paper-doll bag -- slot art), tinted white when purchased / red when not; the purchase row's cost coins + -- afford color; the whole row hidden once GetNumBankSlots() reports `full`. function BenillaBankFrame_UpdateBagRow() local numSlots, full = GetNumBankSlots() for i = 1, BENILLA_BANK_BAG_SLOTS do local button = getglobal("BenillaBankBagButton" .. i) if button then local texture = BenillaGetBankBagTexture(i) button.icon:SetTexture(texture or "Interface\\PaperDoll\\UI-PaperDoll-Slot-Bag") if i <= numSlots then button.icon:SetVertexColor(1.0, 1.0, 1.0) button.tooltipText = "Bag Slot" -- BANK_BAG else button.icon:SetVertexColor(1.0, 0.1, 0.1) button.tooltipText = "Purchasable Bag Slot" -- BANK_BAG_PURCHASE end end end
local cost = GetBankSlotCost(numSlots) BenillaBankFrame.nextSlotCost = cost BenillaMoney_Set("BenillaBankFrameCostMoney", cost, true) if GetMoney() >= cost then BenillaMoney_SetColor("BenillaBankFrameCostMoney", 1.0, 1.0, 1.0) else BenillaMoney_SetColor("BenillaBankFrameCostMoney", 1.0, 0.1, 0.1) end
local purchaseFrame = getglobal("BenillaBankFramePurchaseInfo") if full then purchaseFrame:Hide() else purchaseFrame:Show() end end
function BenillaBankFrame_OnEvent(frame) if event == "BANKFRAME_OPENED" then BenillaBankFrame_SetTitle(arg1) BenillaBankFrame_RepaintItems() BenillaBankFrame_UpdateBagRow() ShowUIPanel(frame) elseif event == "BANKFRAME_CLOSED" then HideUIPanel(frame) elseif event == "PLAYERBANKSLOTS_CHANGED" then BenillaBankFrame_RepaintItems() elseif event == "PLAYERBANKBAGSLOTS_CHANGED" then BenillaBankFrame_UpdateBagRow() elseif event == "PLAYER_MONEY" then BenillaMoney_Set("BenillaBankFrameMoney", GetMoney()) BenillaBankFrame_UpdateBagRow() -- the cost coins' afford color can flip too elseif event == "ITEM_LOCK_CHANGED" then if arg1 == -1 then BenillaBankFrame_RepaintItems() end elseif event == "BAG_UPDATE_COOLDOWN" then -- No bag argument (ref l.243-253's own shape) — BenillaBagSlot_Update's occupied -- leg re-runs the cooldown sweep as part of the full 24-slot repaint. BenillaBankFrame_RepaintItems() end end
function BenillaBankFrame_CloseButton_OnClick() CloseBankFrame() HideUIPanel(getglobal("BenillaBankFrame")) end
-- CloseBankBagFrames (ref BankFrame.lua:119-123), over our popout naming. function BenillaCloseBankBagFrames() for j = 1, BENILLA_BANK_BAG_SLOTS do local frame = getglobal("BenillaBankBagFrame" .. j) if frame and frame:IsShown() then frame:Hide() end local button = getglobal("BenillaBankBagButton" .. j) if button then button:SetChecked(nil) end end end
-- ── The 6 bag buttons (ref BankFrameItemButtonBag_OnClick/_OnShiftClick, BankFrame.lua: -- 171-204): NOT container slots (they hold a whole BAG item, not a stack) — the doll -- pickup idiom BagFrame.xml's BenillaBagBarSlot_* already established for the equipped -- bag slots, reused verbatim here over BankButtonIDToInvSlotID's bag arm (id 1..6 -> -- live 64..69). A held cursor item always PLACES; an empty cursor toggles the button's -- popout window instead (ref: PutItemInBag first, ToggleBag only if that failed). ── function BenillaBankBagButton_OnLoad(button, id) button:SetID(id) button.icon = getglobal(button:GetName() .. "Icon") -- Both buttons, ref-verbatim (BankItemButtonBagTemplate's OnLoad runs -- BankFrameBagButton_OnLoad -> BankFrameBaseButton_OnLoad, BankFrame.lua:12); the vault -- slots get the same pair through BenillaBagSlot_OnLoad. The OnClick below reads no -- button — right-click places/opens exactly as left does. button:RegisterForClicks("LeftButtonUp", "RightButtonUp") button:RegisterForDrag("LeftButton") end
function BenillaBankBagButton_Place(button) PickupInventoryItem(BankButtonIDToInvSlotID(button:GetID(), 1)) PlaySound("BAGMENUBUTTONPRESS") end
function BenillaBankBagButton_OnClick(button) if CursorHasItem() then BenillaBankBagButton_Place(button) return end local id = button:GetID() PlaySound("BAGMENUBUTTONPRESS") -- Only a slot actually holding a bag opens its popout — the reference's ToggleBag on -- a bagless (or unpurchased) slot is a no-op beyond the click sound; the container -- feed reports 0 slots exactly when no bag object sits in the slot. if C_Container.GetContainerNumSlots(4 + id) == 0 then button:SetChecked(nil) return end local frame = getglobal("BenillaBankBagFrame" .. id) if frame then if frame:IsShown() then frame:Hide() else BenillaBagWindow_Update(frame) -- paint before Show (BenillaBagBarSlot_OnClick's own idiom) frame:Show() end button:SetChecked(frame:IsShown()) end end
function BenillaBankBagButton_OnEnter(button) GameTooltip:SetOwner(button, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetText(button.tooltipText or "Bag Slot") GameTooltip:Show() end
-- The Purchase button (ref BankFramePurchaseButton OnClick, BankFrame.xml:478-482) + its -- confirm popup (ref StaticPopup.lua CONFIRM_BUY_BANK_SLOT, l.47-58 — text-only here, see -- the header's money-frame note). Accept queues PurchaseSlot(); the descriptor's byte-2 -- delta is the only success signal (decision 0604) — PLAYERBANKBAGSLOTS_CHANGED repaints. function BenillaBankFramePurchaseButton_OnClick() PlaySound("igMainMenuOption") StaticPopup_Show("CONFIRM_BUY_BANK_SLOT") end
StaticPopupDialogs["CONFIRM_BUY_BANK_SLOT"] = { text = "Do you want to purchase a bank slot for:", -- CONFIRM_BUY_BANK_SLOT button1 = "Yes", button2 = "No", OnAccept = function() PurchaseSlot() end, timeout = 0, hideOnEscape = 1, }

FontString.text: Do you wish to purchase space for an additional bag?
